description: The main interface of a two-interface project whose archive lists the second one first: every specified widget type, the EVENT_SCHEDULER mapped to a schedule; refs and actions without an object dropped; Action suffixes, with an explicit *Action winning over a bare name; PSEUDO_METHOD as ATTRIBUTE; a script action without index; upper-case theme and scene colours; CLUs filtered to the ones used, in document order although CLU_B is used first, including one used only by an action and excluding one used only by a stub, with a serial read through an XML reference; push objects including one through a reference and one outside any CLU; an LED without its editor fields and a broken ON_OFF passed on as {id, type} and skipped; a third page with every type confirmed in 0.10.0 (CAMERA, LED, CONTACT_SENSOR, CONTACT_SENSOR_DOUBLE, SLIDER, MULTISENSOR with the objectAirVco spelling, the legacy ROLLER_SHUTTER), a TV_REMOTE_CONTROL mapped to a remote with its buttons, a widget never sent to a phone whose editor id stands in as omp-…, an LED missing a slider, an LED whose slider kinds are swapped (still a light: a union by type), a legacy roller whose indication is not a string and a camera whose component is not a CAMERA_STREAM (both skipped).
provenance: spec §4.5 text; expectations re-derived by tools/oracles/omp.py and tools/oracles/mapping.py
